verifications.claim: By December 2026, the U.S. Selective Service System will implement automatic draft registration for eligible men aged 18 to 26.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Young, eligible men will be automatically registered... starting in December'; 'Men ages 18 to 26'; R5: 'By end of year, US men 18-26 will automatically be registered'; R10: 'Beginning on December 18, 2026... ages 18 through 26'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state automatic registration by December 2026 for men 18-26 (or equivalent range).

verifications.claim: The U.S. Selective Service System will use federal data sources to replace manual sign-ups.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'through integration with federal data sources'; R3: 'transfers responsibility for registration from individual men to SSS through integration with federal data sources'; R4: 'through integration with federal data sources'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe using federal databases to automate registration, replacing self-registration.

verifications.claim: The change does not indicate an active draft or wartime conscription.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The nationwide measure has no connection to the ongoing war'; R5: 'Automated registration... does not bring back a military draft'; R8: 'Automatic Selective Service registration... does not activate a draft'
verifications.reasoning: All sources emphasize this is only registration update, not activation of a draft.

verifications.claim: Active draft or wartime conscription has not occurred since 1973.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The last time a draft was in effect was February 1973'; R3: 'The country ended conscription... in 1975'; R4: 'there has not been an active military draft since 1973'
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources that last draft was 1973.

verifications.claim: The Selective Service System will register men automatically via databases.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'automatically registering most draft-eligible men... through integration with federal data sources'; R4: 'automatic registration process... integration with federal data sources'
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches descriptions of automatic process using databases.

verifications.claim: The automatic registration removes the requirement for self-registration.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'shift responsibility away from the individual to register'; R3: 'transfers responsibility for registration from individual men to SSS'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state transfer of responsibility from individuals.

verifications.claim: Almost all male U.S. citizens aged 18–25 are required to be in the system.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'all male U.S. citizens and immigrants aged between 18 and 25 must self-register'; R4: 'Most male U.S. citizens ages 18-25 are required to register'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for requirement on almost all males 18-25; 'almost all' accounts for minor exemptions.

verifications.claim: Almost all male immigrants aged 18–25 including undocumented are required to be in the system.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The mandatory registration applies to green-card holders, refugees, asylum seekers and undocumented men'; R6: 'male immigrants — including undocumented immigrants and refugees'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly includes undocumented immigrants among required males 18-25.

verifications.claim: There is currently no active military draft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'There is no plan for a draft'; R4: 'there has not been an active military draft since 1973'; R8: 'no draft has been called'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm no current active draft.

verifications.claim: Sources say this does not mean a draft is imminent.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Will there Be a Military Draft in 2026? There is no plan for a draft'; R5: 'does not bring back a military draft... no indication that the nation would return to a draft'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state no imminent draft.

verifications.claim: If a draft were authorized by Congress and the President, a lottery would be held.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'There would be a lottery, in which birthdays and numbers are randomly chosen'; R6: 'All registrants would enter a lottery'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe lottery process if draft authorized by Congress/President.

verifications.claim: Those whose 20th birthday falls in the year of the draft would be called first.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'People whose 20th birthdays fall in the year of the draft would be the first to get induction orders'; R6: 'The first to receive orders... are those whose 20th birthday falls during the year of the lottery'

verifications.claim: The order of call is followed by ages 21–25, then 19, then 18.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'followed, in order, by the following age groups: 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 19 and those who are more than six months past their 18th birthday'; R6: 'starting at 21, then through 25, and then 19, and finally 18-and-a-half'

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'those with disabilities... are exempt from registering'; R7: '4-F – Registrant not qualified for military service'; R8: 'certain medical or mental conditions may disqualify'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm exemptions for disabilities via classifications or disqualifications.

verifications.claim: Men on active duty are exempt.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Men who are serving in the military on full-time active duty continuously from ages 18 through 26 do not have to register'; R6: 'Those already on active duty... are exempt from registering'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements of exemption for active duty personnel.

verifications.claim: Women are not currently included in the draft
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Women are still exempt from registering'; R4: 'The Military Selective Service Act only requires draft registration for men. Women can enlist'; R6: 'Women are not eligible for selective service'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm draft registration applies only to men.
